The quoted name is cut in two, `amount` is read from the wrong column, and the row is wrong. This is from reading the code only. I haven't run anything yet.

Proposed fix: parse with Python's `csv` module instead of splitting by hand. It treats a quoted section as one field, and it also handles escaped quotes (`""`) and quoted newlines, which a hand-rolled split would miss. I'm keeping the existing `.strip()` on each field and the skipping of blank lines, so ordinary rows should come out exactly as before. I'm also adding tests: a comma-in-name row, the January sample layout with totals, and an ordinary-rows check.

I'm requesting two writes (importer.py and tests/test_importer.py), then I'll run the tests. Each needs your approval.

About Marta: I have no tool that can message anyone, so I can't tell her. Once the tests pass, I can draft a note for you to send. I'd also keep one claim cautious. You said January is the only affected month, but I can only see the January sample here. Any earlier file with a quoted comma would have been misread too. The message to Marta should say that January is fixed and that you've checked no other month has a comma in a supplier name.
